about: One entry per acceptance scenario S1 to S15 from KICKOFF.md, plus tier C entries for things the design adds. ci_path is the deterministic path: named CLI --json queries and harness steps, compared with examples/TRUTH.json where a compare list is given, with every Jev and Claude call replayed and the fixture implementer in place of the implementer agent. evidence_path is run live once and recorded under docs/evidence/. Status turns passing only when every listed test passes on the CI path. Never weaken or delete an entry except through an approved infeasibility decision record.
fixture_note: Every CI path builds its own fixture with cargo xtask fixture, which runs examples/build-fixture and writes OUT/.planroom/config.toml loading examples/packs/ruby, because TRUTH.json lists the healthcheck container and its edges (DR-13). S10 uses --no-packs. It also records OUT as a trusted workspace in a temporary data root (PLANROOM_DATA), so each run's ledger, backups, trust records and hand-off worktrees start empty (DR-48, DR-53), and strict replay counts as consent to every provider (DR-49). The Ruby pack is out of tree, so the first scan deals its one first-load card (DR-48).
